metadata.notes: Celio's scene ends with Bill's favor: take the Meteorite to the man who runs Two Island's Game Corner (pret OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanYouDeliverThisMeteoritePlayer). Out of One Island's Center, south to the harbor, and the Seagallop with the Tri-Pass: before the trip back to Cinnabar with Bill the sailor offers TWO ISLAND, THREE ISLAND and EXIT (pret EventScript_ChooseDestFromOneIsland, MULTICHOICE_ISLAND_23). The ship lands the player at Two Island's harbor (8, 5) (pret sSeagallopSpawnLocations); then north into town, to the Joyful Game Corner's door. Its map is not in PokemonSimulation, so this checkpoint ends outside it; entering starts the Game Corner owner's scene (pret TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_EventScript_HelpFindLostelleScene).

checkpoint.title: One Island's harbor: the Seagallop to Two Island, to the Joyful Game Corner's door

events.why: Out of the Center and south through town to the harbor, above the sailor (8, 6).
The sailor's list: TWO ISLAND, then the Seagallop's crossing to Two Island's harbor.

Up the harbor's stairs into Two Island, east below the Joyful Game Corner's door (39, 9), facing the sign east of it: a press north there walks in (pret TryDoorWarp takes the pressed direction, not the faced one).
